test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A & B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son B’

A % B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

If A & B # C & D @ E % F + G, then how is A related to D?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d5a935d623a41a2055d7118a30cb95a4dc5b577d68921c46f443937a8a4ad0.png] 

Given:

 
 

 A & B
 A is the wife of B
 
 

 A # B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A @ B
 A is the son B
 
 

 A % B
 A is the husband of B
 
 

 A + B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

Now we substitute the values in the given equation:

A & B # C & D @ E % F + G becomes A is the wife of B, B is the father of C, C is the wife of D, D is the son E, E is the husband of F, F is the mother of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4a24475ca12a8c7f58bd821e43410255eaeb86b52ae06bde1fc888f09a310c.png] 

From the chart we can see that,** A is mother-in-law of D.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
